EmailTemplate.subject: Incomplete graduate admission application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Health Solutions at Arizona State University. I see that you started an application with us but have not yet completed it.
Your next steps to complete the application are:
Request your official GRE scores using ASU's institutional code: 4007 Remind your recommenders to submit their letters of recommendation. If applicable, request your pproof of English proficiency using ASU's institutional code: 4007. Send your official hard copy transcripts to:
Regular Mail: Arizona State University Graduate Admission Services PO Box 871003 Tempe AZ 85287-1003
FedEx, DHL, UPS: Arizona State University Graduate Admission Services 1151 S. Forest Avenue, #SSV112 Tempe, AZ 85287-0112
Please reply to this email to let us know when we can expect to receive these remaining materials.
Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
Sincerely,
{!User.Email}
